assets.prompt: Monsters waiting in the dark around a hoard of gold: a slow tense pulse on a frame drum, plucked low strings, a hurdy-gurdy drone and a sparse dark dulcimer theme. Ominous but not scary, it invites the descent. A minor, around 72 bpm. About two and a half minutes at one level.

Dark fantasy dungeon ambience, calm and patient. A low cello drone, a soft frame drum like a slow heartbeat, a sparse dulcimer melody, faint crackle of torches in the background. Slow, around 66 bpm, D minor. About three minutes, the same mood throughout.

A tense dungeon fight. Driving frame drums and taiko at 120 bpm, a low brass ostinato, staccato cellos, a hurdy-gurdy drone underneath. Taut and grim rather than heroic or epic. About ninety seconds at one level of intensity.

The fight with the dragon at the bottom of the dungeon. Heavy timpani and war drums at 110 bpm, deep horns and low brass, tremolo strings, a dark bowed bass. Bigger and more menacing than an ordinary fight, but steady. About ninety seconds at one level of intensity.
A five-second victory flourish after winning a fight: a bright brass call over a frame drum roll, ending on a firm major chord.
A five-second defeat cue after losing a fight: a low cello falling phrase over a muffled drum, ending on a dark minor chord.
A fourteen-second ending theme when the game is over and the treasure is counted: solemn and warm, lute and strings with a horn, resolving calmly.
A nine-second ominous reveal: an ancient lord awakens in the depths. A deep bell toll, a rising low brass cluster, a hurdy-gurdy drone, ending in an unresolved dark chord.
A soft click of a small wooden token placed on a wooden board, very short.
A small iron latch flipped, a short metallic tick.
A parchment sheet unfolded quickly, a short paper rustle.
A parchment sheet folded and laid down, a short soft paper swish.
A dull wooden knock, two quick muted taps on a table, meaning no.
A single small brass bell struck softly, a short clear chime with a quick decay.
A thick cardboard tile slid off the top of a stack, a short dry scrape.
A thick cardboard dungeon tile set down on a table, a firm soft thud.
A cardboard tile turned on the table, a quick short scrape.
A single footstep on packed earth and gravel in a cave: a soft low crunch, muffled and short. No click, no echo.
A gust of warm wind through a torch flame, a low soft whoosh with a crackle of embers, fading. Low and warm, no whistle, no high tones.
Healing at a magic fountain: trickling water and a soft warm rising chime.
An old wooden treasure chest unlocked and its heavy lid creaking open.
Rattling the iron lock of a closed wooden chest that will not open.
Picking up a weapon from the floor: a short metal scrape and a leather strap.
A handful of gold coins dropped into a leather pouch, a short jingle.
A heavy iron key on a ring picked up, a short metallic jingle.
A sword dropped on a stone floor, a short metal clatter.
Two big heavy hardwood dice dropped onto a thick oak table: deep, weighty, hollow wooden thumps, one bounce and a short roll. Low-pitched and solid. No metal, no clicks.
A decisive sword strike that fells a monster: a heavy metal slash and a body falling on stone.
A hero struck by a monster: a heavy blunt blow on leather armour and a short grunt of pain.
Two swords clashing and locking, a ringing metal clang, no one falls.
A dungeon monster growls a short menacing snarl in a stone room.
A huge dragon roars in a deep cavern, a deep rumbling roar with a short tail.
A hero knocked down and dazed: a body falls on stone, a dull ringing in the ears.
A fallen hero rises again: a soft rising shimmer and a warm low hum.
A fireball spell cast: a quick ignition whoosh and a crackling burst of flame.
A spell scroll read aloud and burning away: parchment crackle and a shimmering magical swirl, no voice.
Dark magic thorns burst out of the ground: a sharp creaking of wood and a low hiss.
A fist of ice strikes: crackling frost and a heavy icy crunch.
A curse falls on the hero: a low ominous drone with a whispering wind, no words.
A curse lifted: a soft bright release, a gentle rising chime and a breath of air.
Sneaking past a monster: soft cloth rustle and careful light footsteps on stone.
A heavy wooden token placed firmly on a board, then a short low thud, ending a turn.
A short gentle low harp glissando of three notes, soft and warm, calm and welcoming. No bell, no chime, no high pitch.
A single tick of an old mechanical clock, short and dry.
A wooden chair pulled up to a table, a short scrape.
A heavy dungeon door of iron and oak creaking open, its bolt sliding.
Two swords drawn from their scabbards one after another, ringing steel.
